title: Serialize stale-recovery authority without losing append-only evidence

target.artifact: stale recovery exclusive reservation + collision detector
target.consumer: universal /wc recovery allocator and independent verifier

problem: The current stale-recovery protocol stores each recovery claim at a unique append-only filename. That preserves history but does not provide a single atomic exclusion point. On the live Page Thread Bridge gate, two workers independently passed preflight and created second-recovery claims eight seconds apart; multiple second-recovery runs were then persisted. Therefore 'no overlapping active recovery' is currently a read-time observation, not an atomic invariant, and the same candidate scope can acquire concurrent recovery writers.

live_falsification.observed_result: The run directory contains multiple REC2/recovery runs created after the same stale predecessor. This is durable collision evidence, not a hypothetical race.

mission: Add a recovery-control primitive that preserves every append-only recovery attempt as evidence while atomically allowing at most one non-stale recovery attempt per opportunity to hold terminalization or candidate-mutation authority. Losing contenders must record collision/reload evidence and re-enter allocation instead of starting overlapping recovery work.
acceptance: Concurrent recovery contenders for one opportunity cannot both obtain active mutation/terminalization authority.
Every contender may still leave append-only attempt/collision evidence; history is never deleted or overwritten.
A stale/expired reservation can be superseded only through the existing >=30 minute recovery policy plus CAS/expected-token semantics.
Late original/recovery returns remain reconcilable and are not discarded by the reservation mechanism.
A deterministic test launches at least two simultaneous contenders and proves exactly one ACTIVE_RECOVERY reservation winner while losers record collision/reload outcomes.
An independent verifier flags more than one non-stale recovery run with mutation authority for the same opportunity as FAIL, not as recovered collision success.
No Current, Human Accepted, Served or production /w promotion is implied.

candidate_design.preferred_route: Separate audit evidence from authority. Keep unique append-only recovery-claim files, but require an additional singleton per-opportunity recovery reservation acquired with create-if-absent/CAS. The reservation stores attempt_id, token, acquired_at, latest durable signal, source head/epoch and intended write class. Only its current token authorizes mutation/terminalization. On expiry, a successor CAS-replaces the reservation while preserving prior reservation snapshots/attempt claims.
candidate_design.alternative_route: Use a deterministic recovery generation key derived from opportunity_id + stale predecessor run id and create exactly one claim at that deterministic path. Simpler, but less flexible for serial R2/R3 recoveries and lease turnover unless generation lineage is explicit.
candidate_design.rejected_route: Continue using only unique timestamped recovery-claim filenames plus read-before-create directory scans. The live canary already falsified this under concurrent workers.

value_signals.unblock_value: High: stale recovery is a gate-removal mechanism used by many saturated /wc workers; duplicate recovery authority can turn recovery itself into write collision.
value_signals.compounding_value: High: one control primitive applies to every future stale opportunity and reduces duplicate work during large parallel waves.
value_signals.information_gain: High: this proposal is grounded in a live same-opportunity race with durable claims/runs rather than architecture speculation.
value_signals.human_friction_reduction: Prevents the human/guide from having to notice and reconcile duplicate recovery workers manually.

falsification: Two simultaneous contenders can both obtain active recovery reservation tokens for one opportunity.
A losing contender starts candidate mutation/terminalization despite not owning the active reservation.
Reservation expiry permits takeover before stale-policy thresholds/evidence are satisfied.
The mechanism overwrites or deletes prior recovery claims/runs/returns.
The verifier treats duplicate active recovery writers as PASS.
dedup_note: Existing work covers stale-recovery semantics and lease/retry implementation broadly, but the live Page Thread Bridge evidence demonstrates a narrower unclosed atomicity defect: unique append-only recovery claims do not serialize recovery authority. This candidate is the regression/control-plane fix for that observed race, not a replacement for the broader stale-recovery protocol.
